exposure: Packed Red Blood Cell (RBC) Standardized Transfusion Protocol
cohort: The study included 408 very low birth weight (VLBW) infants (BW < 1500 g) admitted to the GW Hospital NICU, comparing those admitted before (n = 209) and after (n = 199) the implementation of a multifaceted quality improvement program.
finding: There was a non-statistically significant decreasing trend of NEC incidence in the post-implementation group (3.5%) compared to the pre-implementation group (5.3%).
birth_weight: very low birth weight (VLBW) infants, BW < 1500 g
